label: Decision levels
subgoals: Give each decision the level it opens
Find the antecedents of an implied literal in its reason clause
Take the maximum level of the antecedents

label: Nodes, edges and reasons
subgoals: Locate the reason clause of the implied literal
Read each other literal of the clause as a false antecedent
Count one incoming edge per antecedent

label: The conflict and its cone
subgoals: Add the conflict node with edges from the falsified clause's literals
Walk the reason clauses backwards from the conflict
Collect the decisions reached and negate them into a clause
